headline: Search volume halved overnight; margin pushed to 19.5% and beat the Thursday average
commentary:
### The day
- We bought half as much traffic and still cleared **$6,517 at 19.5%**.
  - NP: $6,517 v $8,999 last Thursday
  - Margin: 19.5% v 16.9%
  - Cost: $26,941 v $44,211
- Better than a typical Thursday on profit, well under one on spend.
  - NP: $6,517 v $5,815 eight-Thursday average
  - Cost: $26,941 v $38,705 average
  - Blended EPL: $13.04 v $15.55 average
- November is running ahead of October on both lines.
  - MTD NP: $78,138 v $62,827 last month
  - MTD margin: 16.1% v 14.6%
### What drove it
- The search traffic simply wasn't there — impressions halved and clicks went with them.
  - Impressions: 16,641 v 34,771 last Thursday
  - Clicks: 1,691 v 3,694
  - Search cost: $19,092 v $39,903
- What we did buy was worth more, and cost a shade more.
  - Search EPL: $25.06 v $21.97 last Thursday
  - CPC: $11.29 v $10.80
  - Search NP: $5,121 v $4,744
- **PMAX and Demand Gen bought cheap volume again** and both lost money.
  - PMAX EPL: $3.32 v $12.62 last Thursday
  - PMAX clicks: 702 v 196
  - Combined NP: minus $458
- Every tree came in under its seven-day mark, so nothing isolated.
  - Direct (Inc ZP): $17.33 v $19.60 last seven days
  - Test tree: $14.30 v $17.41
  - Direct Lenders: $18.62 v $20.02
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 12/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| — | No live tests logged | — | — | — |
- Nothing on the test log this week, so no logged change explains it.
watch: Search supply: 16,641 impressions is half last Thursday's, and no impression share came through for the day to tell us whether that's us or the auction.
PMAX has now spent two days buying leads at a few dollars each; $3.32 EPL against a $2.48 CPC doesn't pay for itself.
Ping tree EPLs all sat under their seven-day levels — Direct (Inc ZP) back near $19.60 would make this a one-day dip.
